clips.title: The story
paras: Promising Alliance rogues are sent east from Stormwind’s intelligence headquarters to train in Lakeshire. SI:7 wants them ready for dangerous field work under seasoned operatives.

Renzik 'The Shiv', SI:7’s second-in-command in Stormwind, warns that untrained rogues rarely survive dangerous operations. Sending raw recruits into hostile territory brings casualties instead of intelligence. SI:7 sends promising agents east to the Redridge Mountains, where they train under Lucius, stationed among Lakeshire’s docks.

Lakeshire offers an ideal ground for clandestine training. Gnolls and Blackrock orcs threaten the frontier town, while its piers give Lucius cover to test a rogue’s stealth, reflexes, and lockpicking without attracting townspeople or guards.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Sending you out in the field now would be suicide. Renzik doesn't need another dead adventurer on his hands. Don't fret, though, friend - Renzik is going to get you up to speed.
Make your way to the Redridge Mountains and speak with an associate of SI:7 named Lucius. You will find him hanging around the docks of Lakeshire with the other shady good-for-nothings.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, so your fingers are a little fat, eh? Don't worry, friend, I've turned more useless thieves than you into accomplished adventurers.
